title: Required-cohort rule duplicated in handler and view; tests pin each side independently, not their agreement
detail: The required-cohort rule is expressed twice: handler inlines never_rented||status, common restates it via cohort. Comments say MUST STAY IN SYNC, but guarantor_required_cohort_truth_table_test and cohort_mirror_agrees_with_required_rule_test pin each side independently — a future one-sided edit passes CI while validation and render disagree.
recommended_fix: Add one matrix test asserting application_handler.guarantor_required(values) == common.guarantor_cohort_is_required(common.guarantor_cohort(never_rented, status)) over {never_rented}×{employed,self-employed,student,unemployed,retired,""}. Closes the documented sync gap without coupling handler→view.
